title: Bandits
intro:
Census phase: vanilla data, plus the Ehlnofey target band of each record. The bandits are the six-rung ladder, the chiefs, the hired thugs, the mercenaries, the Reavers of Solstheim and the named bandit leaders, vanilla, DLC and CC. Their lists are the most borrowed in the game (the Silver Hand, the Dawnguard Hunter, the vampire thralls, the bandit-list ghosts, the Soul Cairn souls, the Orcish Invaders, world-encounter NPCs and more): each list row on a family page links to every record that draws it, under *Drawn elsewhere*. Non-bandits that take their level from a bandit list stay on their own kinds' pages with a "borrows its level" note.

Runtime injectors `[verified]` (decompiled quest fragments): the 14 CC Bandit Armor packs `ccBGSSSE050`–`064` each call `LCharBanditBoss.AddForm` with their own chief list at their own level (052 at 2, 053 at 3, 058 at 6, 056 at 10, 064 at 12, 061 and 062 at 15, 055 at 23, 054 at 26, 063 at 32, 059 at 40, 060 at 44, 050 and 051 at 48). 050, 052–056, 058, 059, 061 and 063 inject from their `…_MiscQuest` after chargen (`ccstartafterchargenscript`; 063 waits for player level 32); 051, 060, 062 and 064 inject at stage 100 of their `…_Quest`, when the pack's armor quest completes. `ccBGSSSE057_Quest` (Stalhrim) adds its Reaver Marauder to `DLC2LCharBanditBoss` `[unverified]`. `DLC2Init` adds Nordic weapons and armor to 23 bandit and bandit-boss gear lists; `ccBGSSSE002_StartUpQuest`, `ccBGSSSE041_Quest` and `ccBGSSSE066_Quest` add the CC arrows, Netch leather and staves to `LItemBanditWeaponArrows`, `DLC2LItemBanditArmor` and `LootStaffsWeaponBandit` `[unverified]`.

sweep.title: Membership sweep (2026-10-02)
sweep.text: Every `LVLN` whose EditorID holds "Bandit" (128, base game, DLC and CC) and everything they draw; every NPC in `BanditFaction` 01BCC0 or whose EditorID holds "Bandit"; every record that takes a template from any of them; every placed reference in every cell and worldspace (1,416, three deleted by Dawnguard at `DLC1RedwaterDenExterior`, 30 moved by CC packs: Bloodfall's Lost Knife Hideout, Cyrus, Dragonplate, Orcish, Daedric Mail); every quest that names a bandit list. No plugin overrides a bandit `LVLN`. `EncBandit04TemplateMelee` 01E60D has no level in `Skyrim.esm` (0) and Dragonborn.esm gives it 14. Re-checked 2026-11-12 with a template-chain sweep of every NPC and `LVLN` in the five masters and the CC plugins for the *Drawn elsewhere* tables.
